examples.sentence: 虽然这家宾馆不太好，但总算有个睡觉的地方了。
examples.romanization: suīrán zhè jiā bīnguǎn bùtàihǎo， dàn zǒngsuàn yǒu gè shuìjiào de dìfang le。
examples.translation: Although this hotel is not very good, there is finally a place to sleep.

examples.sentence: 你的论文大概什么时候发表？定下来了吗？
examples.romanization: nǐ de lùnwén dàgài shénmeshíhou fābiǎo？ dìng xiàlai le ma？
examples.translation: When will your paper be published? Have you decided (lit. decided down)?

title: 舍得 (willing (to to let go))
longExplanation: willing (to to let go). Pinyin: shěde

examples.sentence: 把你最喜欢的玩具送给小朋友，你舍得吗？
examples.romanization: bǎ nǐ zuì xǐhuan de wánjù sònggěi xiǎopéngyǒu， nǐ shěde ma？
examples.translation: Give your favorite toys to children, are you willing (to let go)?

title: 舍不得 (unwilling (to to let go))
longExplanation: unwilling (to to let go). Pinyin: shěbude

examples.sentence: 有些人舍不得把钱花在有意思的事情上。
examples.romanization: yǒuxiērén shěbude bǎ qián huā zài yǒuyìsi de shìqing shàng。
examples.translation: Some people are reluctant to spend money on fun things.

examples.sentence: 从此李白刻苦用功，最后成了一位伟大的诗人。
examples.romanization: cóngcǐ Lǐ Bái kèkǔ yònggōng， zuìhòu chéngle yī wèi wěidà de shīrén。
examples.translation: Since then, Li Bai has worked hard and finally became a great poet.

examples.sentence: 假设你的钱用完了呢？你该怎么办呢？
examples.romanization: jiǎshè nǐ de qián yòng wánle ne？ nǐ gāi zěnmebàn ne？
examples.translation: Suppose your money is running out? What would you do?

examples.sentence: 您当年的假设已经被证明是对的。
examples.romanization: nín dāngnián de jiǎshè yǐjīng bèi zhèngmíng shì duì de。
examples.translation: Your assumptions for the year have been proven to be correct.

title: 堆 (a pile, a heap)
longExplanation: a pile, a heap. Pinyin: duī

examples.sentence: 工厂旁边有一个建筑材料堆。
examples.romanization: gōngchǎng pángbiān yǒu yī gè jiànzhù cáiliào duī。
examples.translation: There is a pile of building materials next to the factory.

title: 堆 (to pile, to heap)
longExplanation: to pile, to heap. Pinyin: duī

examples.sentence: 这些零件怎么都堆在这儿啊？
examples.romanization: zhèxiē língjiàn zěnme dōu duī zài zhèr ā？
examples.translation: How are these parts piled up here?

title: 不如 N A (not as A as N)
longExplanation: not as A as N. Pinyin: bùrú N A

examples.sentence: 三家的营业额加起来还不如他一家高。
examples.romanization: sān jiāde yíngyè'é jiā qilai háibùrú tā yījiā gāo。
examples.translation: The turnover of the three companies is not as high as his family.

title: (与其)……不如…… (rather than… it’s better to)
longExplanation: rather than… it’s better to. Pinyin: ( yǔqí)…… bùrú……

examples.sentence: 与其待在家里，不如去外边走走。
examples.romanization: yǔqí dài zài jiālǐ， bùrú qù wàibian zǒu zǒu。
examples.translation: Instead of staying at home, it is better to go outside.

title: 干脆 V (simply, quick and dirty)
longExplanation: simply, quick and dirty. Pinyin: gāncuì V

examples.sentence: 许多亲朋好友建议他干脆把另三家书店挤垮。
examples.romanization: xǔduō qīnpénghǎoyǒu jiànyì tā gāncuì bǎ lìng sān jiā shūdiàn jǐkuǎ。
examples.translation: Many relatives and friends suggested that he simply “squeeze out” the other three bookstores, [quick and dirty]. [That its, drive them out of their business.]

examples.sentence: 我求他帮忙，他答应得很干脆。
examples.romanization: wǒ qiú tā bāngmáng， tā dāying dehěn gāncuì。
examples.translation: I asked him for help, and he readily agreed.

title: 万一 (in the unlikely case where)
longExplanation: in the unlikely case where. Pinyin: wànyī

examples.sentence: 如果鸡蛋都放在一个篮子里，万一不小心就有可能全部打碎。
examples.romanization: rúguǒ jīdàn dōu fàng zài yī gè lánzi lǐ， wànyī bù xiǎoxīn jiù yǒukěnéng quánbù dǎsuì。
examples.translation: If all [your] eggs are placed in one basket, should an accident happen they would all be crushed.

examples.romanization: bùpà yī wàn， jiù pà wànyī。
examples.translation: We’re not afraid of the usual, just the unexpected mishap.
